prompt: Using the commuting table, a student is selected at random from Grade $10$. What is the probability that this student takes the bus? Give your answer as a decimal rounded to the nearest hundredth.
hint: "Selected from Grade 10" restricts the pool. What is the new denominator?

hints.text: "Selected from Grade 10" restricts the pool. What is the new denominator?
The Grade 10 column totals $90$, and $35$ of them take the bus.

learningObjective: Compute a conditional probability from a two-way table.
explanation: The condition "from Grade 10" restricts attention to that column, whose total is $90$.
Within Grade 10, $35$ students take the bus.

alternativeExplanations.title: Three denominators, three different answers
steps: Out of Grade 10: $\dfrac{35}{90} \approx 0.39$ ✓ — same numerator every time. The phrase after "from" or "of those who" names the denominator.
